critic_note: The .patchfrog.yml used for this batch set review.provider/model but not review.critic_model, which at the time defaulted to claude-opus-5 (the Anthropic default) regardless of provider -- every critic call therefore failed with a clean 404 ("models/claude-opus-5 is not found"), correctly classified as ProviderFatalError and gracefully degraded to no-critic aggregation by the existing review service (never crashed, never silently accepted). This sample remains REVIEWER-ONLY Gemini data, not reviewer+critic -- preserved as-is, not rewritten. UPDATE (same PR, after this run): the underlying gap is now fixed at the ReviewConfig normalization layer -- an omitted critic_model now defaults to the same value as the reviewer model, so the minimal config (provider + model only) is sufficient going forward; no .patchfrog.yml workaround is needed for a future run. See validation/gemini_provider/summary.json's config_semantics_fix and CONFIG_SCHEMA_VERSION (1 -> 2).
